QuestInfo.name: [Springtime] Moony-Eyed Portrait
QuestInfo.0: Baby Moon Bunny's favorite portrait of the moon is all faded. See if you can help out...
QuestInfo.1: Stay online for 30 minutes with the #i3994648# #bFaded Moon Picture#k in your possession and it'll soak up enough lunar rays to regain its luster! Talk to Baby Moon Bunny when it's ready.
QuestInfo.2: Baby Moon Bunny looked so happy to have that portrait back. It gave you a gift box as a sign of gratitude.

0.0: #b#h0##k, can you please help me? My mom gave me this portrait of the moon when I was just itty-bitty, but it's getting all faded. Do you think you can fix it?\r\n #i3994648# #b#t3994648#

yes.0: You really think you can fix it? I'm entrusting my #i3994648# #r#t3994648##k to you, #b#h0##k. I heard my grandpa talk about humans restoring photos just #bholding on to them#k. You guys must be magic, huh?
yes.1: I wonder how long it'll take... I hope it's not more than #b30 minutes#k. My attention span isn't super long. Just don't #rlog out with the portrait#k, okay? It's super fragile.

no.0: My grandpa told me to stop cryin' over pictures... He says bunnies don't know anything about restoring photos.

default.0: The portrait still looks all faded...
